prompt: From this report on 3-CMC, state: (a) the total quantity of powder seized and the number of seizures, and the first year from which these totals are counted; (b) the quantity seized in 2021, as given in the main report, in the annex and in the summary, if they differ; (c) the date of the report (month and year) or the date it was submitted.
answer:
**(a) Total powder seized:** The main report says "approximately 2720 kilograms of 3-CMC powder has been seized in Europe," in more than 9000 seizures. Totals are counted from **2014**, the year 3-CMC was first identified on the European market.

**(b) Quantity seized in 2021:** The figures differ between sections:
- **Main report:** "1600 kilograms in 2021 alone."
- **Annex 1 summary:** "seizures of a total of 1 400 kg of powder at the external EU border, originating in India." This 1,400 kg figure refers to customs seizures at the EU external border, so it is not directly comparable to the main report's total.

**(c) Report date:** **November 2021.** The Risk Assessment Report was submitted to the European Commission on 25 November 2021, after the risk assessment meeting on 19 November 2021.
